source_ref: Class 10 Chemical Reactions and Equations - reaction facts and types. Original wording.

items.name: Burning of magnesium ribbon
items.observation: Dazzling white flame; white powder of magnesium oxide is formed

items.name: Heating of lead nitrate
items.observation: Brown fumes of nitrogen dioxide are given off; yellow residue of lead oxide is left

items.name: Heating of ferrous sulphate crystals
items.observation: Green crystals turn white, then brown; smell of burning sulphur

items.name: Thermal decomposition of calcium carbonate
items.observation: Limestone breaks down on strong heating to give quick lime and carbon dioxide
items.use: Manufacture of cement and quick lime

items.name: Decomposition of silver chloride in sunlight
items.observation: White silver chloride turns grey in sunlight

items.name: Electrolysis of water
items.observation: Hydrogen collects at the cathode in twice the volume of oxygen at the anode

items.name: Decomposition of hydrogen peroxide
items.observation: Rapid bubbling of oxygen gas

items.name: Iron nails in copper sulphate solution
items.observation: Blue colour of the solution fades to light green; brown coating of copper on the nail

items.name: Zinc in copper sulphate solution
items.observation: Blue colour fades; reddish-brown copper is deposited

items.name: Copper in silver nitrate solution
items.observation: Solution slowly turns blue; shiny silver deposits on the copper

items.name: Sodium sulphate with barium chloride
items.observation: White precipitate of barium sulphate is formed

items.name: Lead nitrate with potassium iodide
items.observation: Yellow precipitate of lead iodide is formed

items.name: Silver nitrate with sodium chloride
items.observation: White curdy precipitate of silver chloride

items.name: Burning of natural gas (methane)
items.observation: Blue flame; heat and light are released

items.name: Quick lime with water
items.observation: Vigorous reaction, hissing sound, and a large amount of heat

items.name: Respiration
items.observation: Slow oxidation of glucose releases energy in cells

items.name: Reaction of sodium with chlorine
items.observation: Vigorous combination forming an ionic salt

items.name: Decomposition of calcium carbonate by heat (endothermic)
items.observation: Absorbs heat continuously while decomposing

items.name: Photosynthesis
items.observation: Occurs only in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll

items.name: Rusting of iron
items.observation: Brown flaky coating of hydrated iron(III) oxide forms on iron exposed to moist air

items.name: Rancidity of fats and oils
items.observation: Change in smell and taste of oily food; prevented by nitrogen flushing and antioxidants

items.name: Reaction of zinc with dilute sulphuric acid
items.observation: Zinc dissolves with brisk effervescence of hydrogen gas

items.name: Reaction of calcium carbonate with hydrochloric acid
items.observation: Brisk effervescence due to carbon dioxide

items.name: Neutralisation of sodium hydroxide with hydrochloric acid
items.observation: Acid and base cancel each other; salt and water are formed with heat evolution
